servinfo.title: Oil Pump Assembly Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Remove engine assembly from vehicle.
Remove water pump drive belt.
Remove crankshaft pulley bolt (1).
To lock crankshaft pulley (2), use special tool as shown in figure.
Remove crankshaft pulley bolt (1).
If it is hard to remove, use special tools.
Remove cylinder head cover.
Remove ISG.
Remove accessory drive belt upper tensioner and idler pulley.
Remove oil pan and oil pump strainer.
Remove intake VVT actuator (motor part).
Remove oil pump assembly.
Remove crankshaft oil seal from oil pump assembly using a flat-bladed screwdriver or the like, if necessary.
Remove oil gallery O-rings (1), oil gallery O-ring No.2 (2) and OCV O-ring (3).
Remove filter (4) from oil pump assembly, if necessary.
Remove exhaust OCV from oil pump assembly, if necessary.
Remove oil pressure and temperature sensor from oil pump assembly, if necessary.
Clean mating surfaces of oil pump assembly, cylinder block and cylinder head removing oil, old sealant and dust.
Press-fit new oil seal (1) into oil pump assembly (2) using special tool as shown in figure.
Check cleanliness of filter (1), if removed.
Apply engine oil to new oil gallery O-rings (2), new oil gallery O-ring No.2 (3) and new OCV O-ring (4) and install each one to oil pump assembly (5).
Check that dowel pins are installed to cylinder block.
Clean mating surface of oil pump assembly, cylinder block and cylinder head.
Clean mating portions (1) of cylinder block and cylinder head with cleaning solvent particularly.
Apply sealant to mating surface of oil pump assembly as shown in figure.

spec.title: Sealant bead size for oil pump assembly

s1.ptxt: Install oil pump assembly noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Apply engine oil to oil seal lip.
Align straight lines (1) of oil pump inner rotor with straight lines (2) of crankshaft sprocket.
Install oil pump assembly within 2 minutes after applying sealant.
Check O-rings and gasket for proper fit.
Use care so that oil seal lip is not damaged and oil seal spring is not coming off.

s1.ptxt: Tighten oil pump bolts No.1 and No.2 in numerical order (“1” – “15”) evenly and gradually to specified torque.
Wipe off excessive sealant squeezed out from oil pump assembly at the lower end.
Install new oil pressure and temperature sensor to oil pump assembly, if removed.
Install exhaust OCV, if removed.
Install intake VVT actuator (motor part).
Install accessory drive belt upper tensioner and idler pulley.
Install ISG.
Install cylinder head cover.
Install oil pan and oil pump strainer.
Clean crankshaft pulley and apply engine oil to sealing surface (1).
Insert crankshaft pulley (1) aligning key groove (2) with key (3) on crankshaft.

attention4.ptxt: Turning over of oil seal lip or coming off of the inside spring will cause oil leakage.
While inserting crankshaft pulley, pay attention not to damage oil seal lip nor disengage the inside spring.

s1.ptxt: Hold crankshaft pulley (1) with special tool and tighten crankshaft pulley bolt (2) according to the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Tighten crankshaft pulley bolt to 25 N·m (2.5 kgf-m, 18.5 lbf-ft).

s1.ptxt: Install water pump drive belt.
Install engine assembly from vehicle.
